"[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which is set during the [[Rebellion era|Rebellion]] and [[New Republic era]]s ([[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]&ndash;[[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]; see {{Blog|holocron|24|Star Wars Eras}}), places the [[Galactic Republic–Mugaari war]] within the [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]] before its events but "[[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]" before the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]], which the text dates to "nearly [[400 BBY/Legends|four centuries]]" prior to its setting. This establishes an approximate [[Time/Legends|time]] frame of [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]&ndash;[[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]] for the war.<noinclude>
